ItemID: unavailable; Title: Be Not Nobody; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Piano-led pop does not fit the heavier music I want right now.

ItemID: unavailable; Title: Dark Side Of The Moon; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its atmospheric classic rock feels less suited to my current appetite for heavier music.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Aenima       Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: My recent Tool listening makes another heavy, intricate Tool album an immediate choice.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Kid A; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its electronic and experimental mood is not what I am seeking right now.
